infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Fern uses your microphone for hands-free voice cooking — say recipes, add items, and plan your week without touching your phone.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Fern listens for your voice commands to plan meals and navigate the app hands-free.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Fern detects when you arrive at your grocery store so it can open your shopping list automatically.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Fern uses background location to detect when you arrive at your grocery store and notify you to start shopping.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Fern uses background location to detect when you arrive at your grocery store and notify you to start shopping.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Fern uses your camera to photograph your fridge or pantry so it can suggest recipes from what you have.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Fern needs access to your photos so you can pick fridge or pantry photos to find recipes from what you have.
